verdict.rationale: The only support is community comments calling Kimi K3 an "open-weight" and "open source" model, which implies the model weights can be run on your own hardware. No vendor documentation in the pack describes self-hosting. The documented products (Kimi Code CLI, Desktop, the assistant app and the API) all connect to Kimi's hosted platform via login or API keys. Missing for 10: first-party docs on downloading or licensing the weights, self-hosting or deployment instructions, any self-hostable version of the assistant or agent stack, and hands-on reports of running it locally.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
